authority_note: An instance is recorded only when a REAL named user at a real institution performed a registered task against a stated evidence snapshot. Claude may prepare the task, the artifact and the capture form; Claude may never record the user's action, the outcome, or the decision owner's judgement. Those fields are written from what the institution itself reports, and an instance missing them stays incomplete rather than being estimated.
counting_rules: One artifact used by one user for one decision is ONE instance, however many products it generated.
Two users at the same institution doing the same task are two instances of ONE adoption, not two adoptions.
Internal testing, founder demonstration, and any run by Claude or Codex are never instances.
A refused, failed, null or abandoned instance is recorded and counted in the denominator. Retaining these is the point; an evaluation that only keeps successes measures nothing.
An instance whose outcome is not yet known is 'open', never 'successful'.
